item.title: “I Didn’t Intentionally Ignore the Alaafin” — Olubadan Opens Up
item.description: The Olubadan of Ibadanland, Oba Rashidi Ladoja, has explained that he did not deliberately ignore or snub the Alaafin of Oyo, Oba Abimbola Owoade, during a recent interfaith event in Ibadan, Oyo State.The incident, which went viral on social media, happened on Monday at an interfaith programme organised by the Oyo State Government at the Grand Space near the Oyo State House of Assembly. Videos from the event had sparked public debate, with many interpreting Oba Ladoja’s actions as disrespectful.
